question: Can explicitly fitting the two paired component energies materially improve the existing interaction family while retaining the original physical gates and electrical-response quality?

start.reason: Last measured admitted Jacobian origin with all25 physical gates; exact first24 derivative vectors can be reused. The tested half point is not substituted for this start.

targets: Unchanged common-basis paired P8/B8/P9/B9; electronic plus separately recorded D4. No absolute-parent target or raw-cluster CC substitution.

objective.formula: q=max(J_P/J_P_origin24, J_B/J_B_origin24), with J_P=(e_P8^2+e_P9^2)/2 and likewise B.
objective.component_scale_meaning: Fixed initial-error normalization balances fractional repair of two consumed diagnostic blocks, not likelihood weights or physical uncertainty.

actual_acceptance.objective_rule: Select lowest q among complete admitted trials and current. Require reduction greater than1e-10*max(1,abs(q_current)); current wins ties, otherwise earlier declared fraction wins ties. Derivative probes are never candidates.
actual_acceptance.tradeoff: A component or response block may worsen relative to the previous iterate, but each remains at or below its fixed origin24 ceiling. No per-step monotonic response ratchet.

proposal.start: zero parameter displacement, auxiliaryq=current measured q
proposal.model: Linearized residual vectors; full squared norms for P/B and four old blocks; original ten energy and fifteen category-balanced body-force gates reconstructed with unchanged thresholds.
proposal.derivative_scheme: Original12parameter central probes at +/-0.005 normalized, clamped only in probe design to original box with exact nonzero actual spans recorded;24 vectors/origin. Reuse exact saved first24 probes.
proposal.witness_rule: Independently recompute each declared fraction using scalar residual arithmetic. Native trials require finite valid in-box vectors, all predicted physical gates and fixed block ceilings without physical-threshold relaxation, and strictly improved auxiliaryq. Failed solver statuses stay failed; their fractions require strictly positive residual-constraint margins and provide feasibility witnesses only. No retry, new fraction, second solver or optimizer-convergence assertion.

stop_rules: Eight outer steps or any hard budget exhausted; report budget termination separately from convergence.
Stop the campaign if no declared fraction qualifies, or no complete admitted trial improves q.
Stop new launches on native numerical/admission failure; retain unfinished batch and do not select from it.
Stop early if both actual paired component RMS errors<=1kcal/mol while all unchanged physical/response constraints pass. This is a development target, not physical qualification.

milestones.substantive_recovery: Report whether both component RMS errors improve over the original initial model and q<=0.25 (at least50percent RMS reduction for each versus origin24). This diagnostic milestone neither changes selection nor releases validation.
milestones.full_development_target: Both paired component RMS<=1kcal/mol with original25gates and fixed response ceilings; reference-method limitations retained.

reuse: Fresh ledger and immutable exact scientific cache identities; import saved origin24 and24probes through completed fit admission, retain their authoritative saved scores/chi and original costs. Do not touch the old ledger or use exact derived-LAPACK replay. Static48 terms reused; unchanged-metal cells reused for derivative vectors.
execution: Source preparation first. Root binds independently reviewed source/preparation and actual execution envelope before any fit run. Preferred12workers within current authorized16aggregate login allowance if Slurm remains saturated; otherwise standard_expand12CPU single task with current standard policy. No fake scheduler fields.
postselection: One consumed eight-cycle trimer regression after independent final selection review; six previously omitted trimer native evaluations plus exact reuse of two existing states. Separate reviewed release, no fitting to this postselection result in this campaign. No automatic fresh validation/production.
non_goals: No new quantum references, geometry generation, new MACE model, donor refit or production change in this campaign.
No claim that finite failure proves global inadequacy of the interaction family.
No automatically repeated8-step campaign or altered acceptance thresholds.
